description: This file defines a generic class BufferWriterBox that implements IBufferWriter<byte> by wrapping another buffer writer, providing a boxing mechanism for buffer writers in Orleans.Serialization.

classes.name: BufferWriterBox<TBufferWriter>
classes.description: A generic class that boxes another buffer writer, implementing IBufferWriter<byte>.

methods.name: BufferWriterBox
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer writer being boxed.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Provides a reference to the underlying buffer writer.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the buffer writer by a specified count.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> segment from the buffer writer.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> segment from the buffer writer.
